name: @plusguard/reels
description: Shoppable reels for a store: a strip of video cards — each a group of clips, each clip with its own product — that opens into a full view. Up and down between groups, left and right within one, the product beside the video on a computer and under it on a phone. No dependencies.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,dom.iterable,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
